Method of Attack: Backdoor on-premise Microsoft Exchange servers using PowerShell-based malware; communicates with command-and-control server via Exchange Web Services (EWS) API sending base64-encoded commands in emails with subject 'Update Microsoft Edge'; enables execution of commands to deliver additional payloads and exfiltrate files
Impacted Systems: United Arab Emirates government organization systems
Attack Vector: Phishing email containing archived malicious executable
Indicators of Compromise: Emails with subject 'Update Microsoft Edge' containing base64-encoded commands
Use of Exchange Web Services (EWS) API for command-and-control communication
